description: The new top-p docstring promises a crossing token that the existing implementation generally excludes.
trigger: A normalized sorted distribution crosses P after its first token, for example [0.5, 0.25, 0.125, 0.125] with P=0.625.
expected_behavior: Under the new description, retain the smallest leading set whose cumulative probability exceeds P: the first two tokens in this example.
actual_behavior: The implementation preserves the first token unconditionally and retains subsequent tokens only when their inclusive cumulative probability is <= P, leaving just the first token in this example.

verification.description: Whole-parent-tree search found TopPSampler constructing this step in both temperature-order branches. CustomSampler.forward directly invokes step.run. The existing preset docstring describes <= P with at least one candidate; DefaultSampler uses min-p instead.
verification.limits: External custom compositions were not inventoried.

verification.description: Computed inclusive cumulative sums and reproduced the unshifted mask, then compared it with the documented crossing-prefix rule.
verification.limits: Standard-library scalar model, not repository execution.
